description: This file contains functions and types related to monitoring, inspecting, and managing the health and restart process of a Gateway service, including port health checks, runtime inspection, and process termination.

methods.name: hasListenerAttributionGap
methods.description: Checks if port usage indicates a gap in listener attribution, especially when no listeners are present but errors or hints suggest process details are unavailable.

methods.name: listenerOwnedByRuntimePid
methods.description: Determines if a port listener is owned by the runtime process ID.

methods.name: looksLikeAuthClose
methods.description: Identifies if a close code and reason resemble an authentication closure.

methods.name: confirmGatewayReachable
methods.description: Probes the gateway to check if it is reachable via WebSocket, considering environment variables for auth.

methods.name: inspectGatewayPortHealth
methods.description: Inspects the health of a gateway port, including port usage and reachability.

methods.name: inspectGatewayRestart
methods.description: Inspects the current state of the gateway service, port usage, and runtime to determine health and ownership.

methods.name: shouldEarlyExitStoppedFree
methods.description: Determines if the restart process should early exit based on runtime and port status.

methods.name: withWaitContext
methods.description: Augments a snapshot with wait outcome and elapsed time.

methods.name: waitForGatewayHealthyRestart
methods.description: Waits until the gateway service is healthy after restart, with retries and timeout.

methods.name: waitForGatewayHealthyListener
methods.description: Waits until the gateway port reports as healthy.

methods.name: renderPortUsageDiagnostics
methods.description: Generates diagnostic strings for port usage status.

methods.name: renderRestartDiagnostics
methods.description: Generates diagnostic strings for the gateway restart snapshot.

methods.name: renderGatewayPortHealthDiagnostics
methods.description: Generates diagnostic strings for port health snapshot.

methods.name: terminateStaleGatewayPids
methods.description: Terminates process trees for given PIDs and returns the list of terminated PIDs.
